evidence.note: Guarded.exec: consent lookup, absolute argv[0] check, hash re-verification via workflow.VerifyCmds, and exact env allow-list all precede execution; refusals before exec leave data.Name empty so they are never audited.

execRunner uses argv only (no shell), Setpgid plus SIGKILL to the process group on cancel, WaitDelay, and a cappingWriter bounded at MaxOutput+1 so overflow is detectable; timeout vs parent cancellation vs spawn failure are distinguished.
New source file has adjacent tests: internal/fsm/cmdexec/cmdexec_test.go covers the real runner, the guarded wrapper, and the capping writer, satisfying the tests-for-source-changes rule.

1 MiB JSONL line cap with buffer sized maxJSONLLineBytes+2 matches bufio.ScanLines needing room for the terminator; scanner.Err() is still returned so an oversized line surfaces as an error rather than silent truncation.
Behavior is covered by internal/findings/findings_test.go TestReadersAcceptOneMiBLines and the adjacent boundary cases, so this is not an untested source change.
The TODO and eval( markers in this test are assembled at run time from string fragments as deliberate fixtures; no literal TODO/FIXME marker or executable eval is introduced by this shard.
Documentation only; exit-code and trust-boundary claims match the code (ERR_CMD_NOT_ALLOWED and ERR_CMDS_NOT_ALLOWED both exist as distinct codes).

findings.note: Unescaped pipe inside a Markdown table cell: `DONE(fixed|clean)` splits the row into three columns in a two-column table, so GFM renderers drop or misalign the rest of the exit-0 cell. Escape it as \| or write DONE(fixed / clean).
